ordinance_area_text: No person shall fish or hunt or shoot within the grounds of the cemeteries or to discharge any firearms or fireworks on or over the same.
method: City of Norfolk OpenData RPOS FeatureServer/1 (Parks), features with PARK_TYPE='CEM': the 8 city-run cemeteries (Calvary, Cedar Grove, Elmwood, Forest Lawn, Hebrew, Magnolia, Riverside, West Point).
notes: 8 cemeteries. These match the 8 cemeteries of Norfolk's Bureau of Cemeteries. Private and church cemeteries are excluded; Chapter 12 governs city cemeteries.
recovered: Recovered 2026-11 from public/data/local-areas.geojson (the original source files were lost); geometry carries that layer's 30% simplification.
